items.q: Esther Fulk. My mom was from Arkansas...

ctx.x: Esther Fulk. My mom was from Arkansas, one of three sisters. The other two sisters were electrocuted in a storm, underneath a tree. A strange thing with my

family – in fact there was – in my family there’s been three people who have been electrocuted. My father’s brother was electrocuted in a foundry, and my mother’s two sisters were electrocuted by a bolt of lightning in Arkansas. I’m not laughing because of what happened, but one day, years later, I’m a young kid. My mother and I, we had just gone to the store, and we’re bringing groceries into the house.
